title: Neuroendocrine prostate cancer converges on a fetal pulmonary neuroendocrine-like program.
snippet: Advanced prostate cancers can relapse as neuroendocrine prostate cancer (NEPC), a treatment-resistant state that is independent of androgen receptor (AR) signaling and whose developmental identity remains unclear. We integrated single-cell, bulk, cistrome and spatial datasets across published cohorts and mapped malignant tumor states to human fetal atlases....
